notes: PRICE/MCAP: NYSE ADR close $45.88 on 22-Jun-2026; mcap ~$203bn (companiesmarketcap showed ~$194-195bn intraday earlier — variance is timing/FX). REPORTING: Novo reports in DKK under IFRS; 1 ADR = 1 B-share, ~DKK/USD ~6.4-6.8 over period. Q1 2026 figures are heavily distorted by a one-off ~DKK 26.8bn (~$4.2bn) reversal of a provision tied to the US 340B Drug Pricing Program: REPORTED sales +24% DKK / +32% CER and reported operating profit DKK 59,618m (+54% DKK) are NOT representative; ADJUSTED (ex-340B) sales were DKK 70,063m, -10% DKK / -4% CER, and adjusted operating profit DKK 32,858m, -6% CER. op_margin_pct for last_q uses adjusted basis (32,858/70,063 = 46.9%); reported margin would be ~61.6%. EPS not disclosed in the Q1 release (Novo reports diluted EPS only at H1/FY); FY2025 diluted EPS was DKK 23.03 (+2%). FCF: company headline FY2025 FCF = DKK 28.3bn (after M&A/business development outflows incl. large acquisitions); pre-M&A op cash flow DKK 111,483m less capex DKK 41,711m ≈ DKK 69.8bn — wide gap due to definition, flagged. FCF margin 9.2% on headline basis (~22% pre-M&A). ROIC ~40% per aggregators (not cleanly broken out in IR excerpt). SBC: Novo is European pharma with minimal share-based payment (estimated ~0.5% of revenue / ~2% of FCF, not separately material; exact note not extracted — ESTIMADO). NET DEBT: DKK total debt ~101.2bn less cash/ST investments ~32.6bn ≈ DKK 68.6bn ≈ ~$10.7bn (incl. leases); StockAnalysis shows higher ~$19.25bn using ADR-level cash $3.34bn — discrepancy likely cash classification; ND/EBITDA ~0.4x, comfortably investment-grade, NOT net cash. PEG: not available from sources (negative near-term EPS growth makes PEG meaningless this FY). DROP CLASSIFICATION = MIXED: stock ~-37% over 52 weeks and ~-67% off Jun-2024 ATH (~$137 ADR). FY2025 still grew (sales +10% CER), but FY2026 guidance is the company's first GUIDED CONTRACTION (-4% to -12% adjusted), driven by genuine deterioration — intensifying US GLP-1 competition (Eli Lilly, compounded semaglutide), Wegovy/Ozempic pricing pressure, pipeline setbacks (CagriSema below expectations) — combined with a valuation de-rating from an extreme prior multiple (fwd P/E ~26.8x 5y avg down to ~14.7x). So the drawdown reflects BOTH genuine fundamental slowdown AND fear/multiple-compression, hence 'mixed' rather than pure fear_rotation or pure genuine_deterioration. Positive offsets: oral Wegovy (pill) US launch strong (>200k weekly Rx, 1.3m total Rx, DKK 2,256m in Q1) and guidance was raised modestly in May 2026.
